items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: That band was the most fantastic band, it was a beautiful band, Teddy Hill. And the trumpets, they could play so high, all of them, and Dickie Wells played right up high with them.

ctx.x: Of course Frankie Newton passed. And Dickie Wells was the trombone. Here was a trombone player that I don't think nobody would ever get his style. It would be useless to try to copy it. Dickie Wells played the most humorous trombone that I have ever heard.
